definitions.explanation: Kind attention to the feelings and needs of others; emotional care shown toward someone.

examples.japanese: お{心遣|こころづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}します→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心遣|こころづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I was happy about his thoughtfulness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}やか→細やか：13789_komayaka⟧な{心遣|こころづか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (heart) + {遣|つか}い (use, handling) → using one's heart = thoughtfulness

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{心遣|こころづか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}します→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧ - I appreciate your thoughtfulness
- ⟦{細|こま}やか→細やか：13789_komayaka⟧な{心遣|こころづか}い - delicate thoughtfulness
- {心遣|こころづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧ - to be happy about someone's thoughtfulness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気遣|きづか}い→気遣い：07295_kizukai⟧ - concern (more about attentiveness and worry)
- {心遣|こころづか}い - thoughtfulness (more about emotional warmth)
- ⟦{心配|こころくば}り→心配り：07297_kokorokubari⟧ - care (more about attention to details)
